smalldocs builds a website from a [Quarto](https://quarto.org) project. It reads the same
`_quarto.yml` and the same Markdown, and it writes the same kind of site into `_site`: pages with a
navbar, a sidebar and a table of contents, reference pages made from your code, and listings of posts.
The site takes any [Bootswatch](https://bootswatch.com) theme.

smalldocs is one small Python package. It needs no Pandoc, no Deno, no Sass and no TeX. Install it
from PyPI:

```bash
pip install smalldocs
```

Then build a site, or preview it while you write:

```bash
smalldocs render docs      # writes docs/_site
smalldocs preview docs     # serves it at http://127.0.0.1:4200 and reloads on every change
```

## What it does, and what it does not

smalldocs makes websites only. It makes no PDF, Word, slides or books, and it runs no code: a
notebook shows the outputs it was saved with. A project that uses only what websites need builds
with Quarto or with smalldocs, and the two sites look alike. [From Quarto](guide/from-quarto.qmd)
lists the differences, and `smalldocs check` finds them in your project.
